verdict.rationale: The evidence shows LLM inference across several model families (Qwen, 7B to 70B LLaMA-class models) and multimodal vision support. The README shows a VLM session, and users confirm Gemma-3 vision works well via llama-mtmd-cli. Missing for 10: any evidence of MoE model support, embedding model support, or the breadth claim of hundreds of architectures.
